morphology_rules: Aenar are visually related to Andorians but remain a distinct profile.
Little or no skin/hair pigmentation is a defining presentation cue.
Two Andorian-related antennae remain primary persistent species morphology.
Antenna tip structure may include the reported funnel-tip indentation.
Blindness must be represented without turning every individual into an identical eye treatment.
identity_rules: Antenna geometry and underlying face remain persistent individual identity.
Low-pigmentation presentation does not justify cloning one pale-blue/white face across the population.
Hair and clothing remain individual/cultural/organizational layers.
Any accessibility device or interface adaptation requires actual character/environment state.
forbidden: treating Aenar as merely white Andorians
automatic closed-eye or opaque-eye stereotype without sourced individual state
telepathy visualized as generic glowing psychic effect by default
pacifism encoded as a fixed facial expression
